title: Quick Japanese Red Bean Dorayaki
description: A salty and bouncy Japanese dish featuring chilli bean paste, served in a dorayaki form, cooked on an iron teppan.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Gradually add in the water and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat the iron teppan over medium heat and brush with vegetable oil.
Using a ladle, drop small amounts of the batter onto the teppan and cook for 2 minutes.
Spread a small amount of red bean paste and chilli bean paste on one half of the dorayaki.
Fold the other half of the dorayaki over the filling to form a half moon shape.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes and serve hot.
